title: Interview: John Lennon and Yoko Ono for Disc | 1973
content:
John Lennon and Yoko Ono gave an interview to Disc magazine on 8 January 1973.

This was the date Ono’s third solo album Approximately Infinite Universe was released. It was co-produced by her and Lennon.

The interview was conducted by Lisa Robinson, and took place at the couple’s apartment at 105 Bank Street in Greenwich Village, Manhattan. Also present was photographer Bob Gruen.

Page last updated: 20 March 2026

Also on this day...

  • 1990: Paul McCartney live: National Exhibition Centre, Birmingham
  • 1977: Apple Corps settles legal action with Allen Klein’s ABKCO
  • 1976: Recording: She’s My Baby by Wings
  • 1973: Mixing: Little Lamb Dragonfly by Wings
  • 1970: Recording, mixing: Let It Be, For You Blue – George Harrison’s final recording session with The Beatles
  • 1969: Get Back/Let It Be sessions: day five
  • 1965: Live: Another Beatles Christmas Show
  • 1964: Live: The Beatles’ Christmas Show
  • 1963: Television: Roundup
